_comment: Ink master lists. OPP set extracted from 40KG example In!V18:W30. Flexo set from 25KG example. Used to populate the N ink color rows when the user answers 'số màu in'. Per-color kg is design-specific and left for the print shop (production) to fill.

opp.name: Mực in OPP LW62 White (Trắng) Ariang
Mực in OPP 79 Green (Xanh lá) Ariang
Mực in OPP LY11-23 Yellow (Vàng chanh) Arirang
Mực in OPP 16 Red (Đỏ đậm) Arirang
Mực in OPP 11 Red (Đỏ cờ) Arirang

usage: After the user states số màu in = N, take the first N entries of the chosen list (or the specific colors they name) and write them into the ink rows of the 'In' sheet material table (columns C/D). Leave the kg (column G) blank for the print shop unless the order specifies amounts.
